purpose: Teach: 一世/一丸/私用/線引き/お披露目/品位/要人/手先

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、犯罪削減、絶対、一世、絶対、を、絶対、風靡する、絶対、勢いです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're fully committed to reducing crime with absolute determination and momentum.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady cadence with quiet pride. Speaks from prepared conviction, not performance. Each clause lands with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、一丸、絶対、と、絶対、なられて、絶対、頼もしいですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. It's reassuring to see the police working together with such commitment.
lines.style: Genuine agreement, not merely echoing. Slight nod in the voice. Warm but respectful—acknowledging professionalism without obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察車両の、本気で、絶対、私用、絶対、絶対なきよう、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We maintain strict protocols regarding police vehicles—no personal use whatsoever.
lines.style: Formal, procedural. Matter-of-fact delivery. Each point stated as established fact, not negotiable. Professional distance but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、業務の、絶対、線引き、絶対、市民に、絶対、ご説明、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've made sure citizens understand exactly where those lines are drawn.
lines.style: Confirming, careful. Shows engagement with the detail. Slight emphasis on 'understand'—he's caught the importance of transparency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 新型装備の、本気for、絶対、お披露目、絶対、警察、絶対、開催します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll be holding a public unveiling of our new equipment soon.
lines.style: Forward-looking, controlled enthusiasm. Announcement-level clarity. Professional but not stiff—there's quiet pride in what's coming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、品位、絶対、保たれていらっしゃいますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. You clearly maintain the highest standards of conduct.
lines.style: Sincere recognition. Slower pace on 'clearly'—he means it. Respectful but not deferential. Meeting professionalism with professionalism.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 国賓、本気で、絶対、要人、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We handled security for the state visitors and dignitary protection personally.
lines.style: Statement of fact, quietly significant. No inflation in the voice—the work speaks for itself. Steady, composed, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の、本気で、絶対、手先、絶対、と、絶対、なって、絶対、ご奉仕、絶対、続けていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. You've shown you're truly in service to the citizens—that commitment continues.
lines.style: Warm close to the exchange. Reflective, slight pause before 'continues.' Genuine, not flattering. The voice of someone who has heard and believed.
